findings.note: HB 1213 (chief patron): a voter who signs an affirmation statement instead of showing valid ID, in person absentee or on Election Day, must also give full name, year of birth and last four digits of Social Security number if any. Left in the Privileges and Elections committee on 2026-02-18.

findings.motion: Read third time and passed House (92-Y 6-N 0-A)
findings.note: HB 78, elections administration: makes certifying results a ministerial duty of local electoral boards, with removal and civil penalty for refusal. She voted yes on House passage. Related election-law vote, not a voter ID vote.

findings.passage: It is paramount to restore the trust and integrity of our elections because no citizen should question whether their vote has been accurately collected or counted for who or what they voted for. Delores says she will fight to audit future elections and use common sense voter identification protections.
findings.note: Platform summary on the outlet's candidate-profile page for her 2023 House race, written in the third person; it may be campaign-supplied text and is not confirmed as her exact wording. Speaks of auditing elections and voter identification protections.
